data.name: Radhey
data.gender_notes: Radhey is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Radhey is a name of Lord Krishna, who is known to bring joy and delight to those around him. In Hindu mythology, he is often depicted as the embodiment of love and the protector of the earth. The name Radhey carries the meaning “Joy, Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Radhey usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Radhey represents the divine love and joy that can be found within oneself and in the world around us. It serves as a reminder to cherish every moment and to share love and happiness with others.
data.etymology: Radhey belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Radhey total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
